<h1>golem</h1>

[`{golem}` is an opinionated framework for building production-grade `{shiny}` applications.]{.gv-pkg-tagline}

It provides a set of tools to help you build a `{shiny}` application in a structured way automates routine tasks, facilitate deployment, and is extendable to feat your needs.
